course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Reposting: replace one effect, preserve another
goal: Verify repeat/replacement/unposting without duplication or losing another recorder.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P5. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A user posts the same document again. If minutes double, the successful command hides an accounting defect. Check repeat, change, and unposting separately for two documents.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: A repeatable transformation
paragraphs: Posting transforms the current document into a movement set. Identical input should yield an equivalent set regardless of repetition. Compare dimensions, resources, periods and recorder—not merely one total. Opposite duplicates can cancel numerically while leaving invalid records.

Begin with own 30/45 requests totaling 75. Reposting the first is not another 30-minute fact: movements represent current document state rather than button presses. The handler clears and rebuilds its own object’s set.

sections.title: Add only the missing part of your own setup
paragraphs: Retain P5 work and its DT. Use a new separately restored copy; preserve older fields/functions and do not reload a full CF over custom work.
Reuse module 5 Трудозатраты/handler: clear only this object’s Движения.Трудозатраты, map ДлительностьМинут and retain automatic deletion on unposting.

Preserve the УчебныеДанные common module. Each experience shows its complete preparation. If НовыйНаборРегистров already exists, do not add another definition:retain it and append only the new function. Do not load a full CF over your work.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The worked path is 75→75→90→45→0:repeating does not double; editing the first request replaces 30 with 45; unposting it preserves the second request’s 45; unposting the second removes the remaining own movements.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: A change replaces the prior effect
paragraphs: Changing 30 → 45 replaces the recorder’s old effect under the agreed policy. Appending 45 gives 75 incorrectly. For multiline documents, test a removed line: its old movement must disappear. Define behavior for an empty document too.
Changing the first 30 → 45 replaces its effect, giving 90 rather than 120. Unposting it leaves the second 45; unposting the second leaves 0 for this own customer, without clearing other customers.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: After unposting the second document, may the whole customer register be cleared to obtain 0?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Each document owns its movement set. Synthetic data does not remove the operation boundary:unposting the second must not alter the first.

sections.title: Failures must not mix versions
paragraphs: Failure between removing old and writing new records must not leave a partial effect. Inject failure only in a new copy and test atomicity. Reread document/register in a fresh session. Transactions and locks address different concerns: one change’s consistency versus interacting concurrent changes.
A parameterized query checks each stage. A correct final 0 could hide an earlier duplication, so retain all five claims:75, 75, 90, 45, 0. Unposting retains document identity.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram shows the worked example’s first four states. Unposting the second next gives 0. The new task additionally counts rows and reverses the unposting order.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Checking only the total can hide extra positive and negative rows that cancel each other. The new task checks row count and minutes together.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Use a matrix beyond the happy path
paragraphs: Use post 30, repeat 30, change 45, remove a line, reverse, repost. Record counts and movement identities at every step. Include another recorder to expose accidental deletion of someone else’s set. Preserve both the current invariant and independent earlier documents.

A31/45 negative set gives 76 despite the same count. The initial 75 expectation must detect it. Specify a separate injected posting failure to check atomic old/new state; concurrent posting needs suitable separate sessions and is not established by one file-base experiment.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Post new requests of 20 and 40:2 rows/60. Change the first to 50 and repost:2/90. Unpost the second:1/50, the first remains. Unpost the first:0 rows. Filter every query by the own customer.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.
